identity.command_policy: Finite-value validation only; no custom command envelopes, clipping or joint-position aborts. Original simulator behaviour retained.
identity.trace_policy: Every 10ms plus terminal observation; differences on shared sampled times, not identical states.
identity.feature_calculation: target37_v1: baseline inputs cast to float32 first; geometry in float64; dx=target_x-base_x, dy=target_y-base_y, psi=base_yaw; body_x=cos(psi)*dx+sin(psi)*dy; body_y=-sin(psi)*dx+cos(psi)*dy; distance=hypot(dx,dy); error=atan2(dy,dx)-psi; heading=atan2(sin(error),cos(error)); heading=0 when dx=dy=0 after float32 input casting; append four float32 features.

preprocessing.output_policy: Training-fitted standardisation; predictions inverted for physical-unit metrics

target37.stop_reason: Target not reachable: closest pose reached at t=10.33s (best EE error 0.3225 m, current 0.3388 m)

actuator_limits.note: Informational only: no additional evaluation command/position limits; existing simulator actuator behaviour is unchanged.

production_joint6_initial_state.note: Original production pose preserved; informational only, no custom position guard.

target37.maximum_policy: Finite raw predictions, including rejected commands; nonfinite values recorded in guard_violation.
target37.minimum_policy: All observed 1ms steps, including terminal observation
